state.project: A public pilot of the consensus clock. Humans vote whether a shared process is ready to end. Entry threshold is 75% support sustained for 7 days. Only verified humans count. Models advise but never vote or hold keys.
state.known_uncertainty: Quorum was Jev's least stable earlier choice: quorum plus geographic/group spread 0.42, no quorum 0.32, absolute floor 0.21.
state.pilot_scale: Small first pilot, expected tens rather than thousands of verified people. It must be runnable and honest, not cosmetically successful.
state.provenance: All candidate pools and labels are ours. Jev supplies the choices and full distributions.

pool_source: All candidate pools and labels are ours. Jev supplies the choices and full distributions.

quorum_rule.instructions: Choose the exact quorum rule for the first small public pilot.

criteria.q12_anywhere: At least 12 verified active human voters; no spread rule.
criteria.q20_anywhere: At least 20 verified active human voters; no spread rule.
criteria.q20_3regions_3each: At least 20 verified active voters total, with at least 3 voters in each of 3 self-declared broad regions.
criteria.q30_3regions_5each: At least 30 verified active voters total, with at least 5 voters in each of 3 self-declared broad regions.
criteria.q30_4regions_3each: At least 30 verified active voters total, with at least 3 voters in each of 4 self-declared broad regions.
criteria.q50_5regions_5each: At least 50 verified active voters total, with at least 5 voters in each of 5 self-declared broad regions.
criteria.no_quorum_measure_only: No minimum; always publish the count and treat every result as measurement only.

quorum_floor.instructions: Ignoring spread, choose the minimum verified active voter floor.

quorum_spread.instructions: Choose the minimum spread requirement for the first pilot.

reset_rule.instructions: Choose the opposition/reset rule that best balances stability against trapping the clock in stale apparent agreement.

criteria.opp40_48h: Reset when active opposition is at least 40% for 48 continuous hours.
criteria.opp50_72h: Reset when active opposition is at least 50% for 72 continuous hours.
criteria.opp50_7d: Reset when active opposition is at least 50% for 7 continuous days.
criteria.opp60_72h: Reset when active opposition is at least 60% for 72 continuous hours.
criteria.opp60_7d: Reset when active opposition is at least 60% for 7 continuous days.
criteria.below75_72h: Reset after support stays below the 75% entry threshold for 72 hours, regardless of explicit opposition.

motivation.instructions: What gives humans enough reason to vote in a first pilot without corrupting the test with a large prize?

criteria.mechanism_only_curiosity: Nothing real at stake; invite people through curiosity and co-ownership of the experiment.
criteria.elect_test_film: The pilot makes one real small choice participants can care about: elect the pilot's own short test film.
criteria.choose_next_question: The pilot decides the next real question or theme the group will work on.
criteria.symbolic_badge: No substantive outcome, but voters receive a public symbolic founder badge.
criteria.tiny_donation_direction: The result directs a small pre-funded donation between transparent causes.
criteria.two_stage: First a mechanism-only dry run; then a second run that elects the test film if the dry run works.

honest_nothing_at_stake.instructions: Is the pilot honest if it claims to measure readiness while nothing participants care about is at stake?

criteria.true: Yes; a mechanism-only test can honestly measure readiness.
criteria.false: No; without a cared-about consequence it mainly measures curiosity or compliance.

publish_constitution_first.instructions: Should the pilot publish its own short constitution before opening?

criteria.true: Yes; rules, operator powers, success criteria and change process must be public first.
criteria.false: No; publishing it first would burden or bias the pilot.

two_ring_fallback.instructions: If open proof-of-personhood is not ready, should the pilot use an invited verified core whose votes count plus an open non-binding ring shown separately?

criteria.true: Yes; this is an honest fallback if the rings are never blended.
criteria.false: No; wait until the open ring itself can be verified and binding.
